decisions.reason: After several years without renewed visible support, this HVAC-adjacent line looks less distinctive from the firm's core industrial niches, so the option value of waiting now seems lower than redeploying attention and resources elsewhere.

Its earlier indication of strong quality recognition and major market share in marine water cooling suggests a validated niche, and in this firm the cost of keeping such a close-to-core system available is likely modest.

With limited positive evidence since launch and likely overlap with stronger marine cooling offerings, uncertainty has had enough time to resolve without clear upside, making abandonment the more disciplined option.

A compact oil cooler remains closely aligned with the firm's engineering base and customer applications, so despite weak recent visibility the low incremental carrying cost still supports keeping the option open.
As a more component-like extension with no later market signal, this offering appears easier to fold back into project-specific supply rather than maintain as an active standalone product line.

Enhanced heat exchanger tubes fit the firm's R&D-oriented, performance-driven capabilities and can still create value as a technical feature across multiple solutions, so management would be somewhat more inclined to retain than exit.
